event_name: Date 21 October 2018 Time 17:08 2018 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 18 - 21 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 45) and heard the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 31 exceeded the fuel mass flow during lap 1.
offence: Breach of Article 5.1.4 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the telemetry evidence, heard from the driver of car 31 (Esteban Ocon) and team representatives. The Stewards find that the fuel mass flow exceeded 100 kg/hr during Lap 1 of the race.
rules_referenced: Article 5.1.4 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
team: Racing Point Force India F1 Team
title: Doc 51 2018 United States Grand Prix Offence Car 31 Fuel Mass Flow
